basic_details.job_title: ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional II Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional II

application_fee.all_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.age_details: SRF: Max 35 years (relaxable). YP-II: Min 21 years, Max 45 years.
age_limit.details: Senior Research Fellow: Maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/Women, 3 years for OBC. Young Professional-II: Minimum age is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree for SRF; Postgraduate degree for YP-II.
qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow: Master's degree in Vegetable Science/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with 4/5 years bachelor's degree. Those with a 3-year bachelor's degree must have UGC/CSIR/ICAR NET qualification or equivalent or a Ph.D. in any of the above disciplines as prescribed under ICAR guidelines. Desirable: Experience in Vegetable Breeding, molecular breeding, biotechnology, and proficiency in computer application. Young Professional-II: Postgraduate degree in Vegetable Science/Horticulture/Genetics & Plant Breeding/Seed Science & Technology/Biotechnology or allied disciplines of Life Sciences. Desirable: Experience on phenotyping of germplasm, screening techniques for biotic stress tolerance, molecular breeding, knowledge in computer applications, data collection & handling, and statistical analysis.

salary_details.pay_scale: SRF: ₹37,000 + HRA/month (1st & 2nd year), ₹42,000 + HRA/month (3rd year). YP-II: ₹42,000/- Per month (Consolidated).
salary_details.senior research fellow: ₹37,000 + HRA/month for 1st and 2nd year; ₹42,000 + HRA/month for 3rd year, as applicable under ICAR norms.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25 September 2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25 September 2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI recruitment is 25 September 2026, up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional II posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one post for Senior Research Fellow and one post for Young Professional II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Fellow post, a Master's degree in Vegetable Science/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with a 4/5 years bachelor's degree is required. Specific NET qualifications or a Ph.D. are needed for those with a 3-year bachelor's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-II post is between 21 years and 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Research Fellow is ₹37,000 + HRA/month for the first and second year, and ₹42,000 + HRA/month for the third year, as per ICAR norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send a duly filled application proforma and declaration form, along with scanned, self-attested copies of supporting documents as a single PDF file to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the email address for application submission?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there a walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a walk-in interview is scheduled for 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contractual basis.
